landingIntro: Plug in the mouse or its receiver, then pick it from the browser prompt. Settings are read from the device and saved back as you change them.
hidUnsupportedTitle: This browser can't reach USB devices
hidUnsupportedDescription: Open this page in Chrome or Edge on a desktop computer.
waitingForReport: Waiting for the mouse to report in…
pollingRateDescription: How often the mouse reports to the computer.
liftOffDistanceDescription: How far the mouse can lift before the sensor stops tracking.
performanceModeDescription: Trade battery life for lower latency.
highPollingForcesWired: Polling rates above 1000 Hz force wired mode
sleepTimerDescription: Idle time before the mouse goes to sleep.
debounceDescription: Time a click must hold before it counts.
dpiDescription: Sensitivity stages you cycle through with the DPI button.
